div.div:
Notes
*1 Authorization is tenant-wide, so per-user consent is not required
Uses Graph application permissions, domain-wide delegation, as-user
and similar
*2 Make NFS / SMB the primary write path
An S3 access point cannot exceed 50 GiB and cannot write ACLs during
ingest
*3 Without externalised progress there is no resume
SaaS API rate limits will interrupt it. With no resume point the whole
set restarts
*4 Revoke the migration permissions when finished
An app registration holding tenant-wide read permission is itself a
high-value target
